docs.title: Assert Condition
docs.description: Stop the Shortcut with a message when the condition is false.

docs.title: Clear Debug Logs
docs.description: Reset the execution-local debug log to an empty value.

docs.title: Export Local Debug File
docs.description: Return one local JSON/text File without saving, sharing or uploading. Fully redacts payloads by default. Explicit redactSensitive:false exports only Text as base64-encoded UTF-8; other payloads report UNSUPPORTED_PAYLOAD_TYPE. Dates/labels are not collected; includeDates:true is rejected. Options are compile-time literals. Native runtime acceptance remains required.

docs.title: Export QA Structured Trace Snapshot
docs.description: Combine the execution-local QA trace buffer into a deterministic JSON envelope for QA inspection or callback export without mutating __cherri_debug_log.

docs.title: Finish Debug Session
docs.description: Preview native objects with optional Creation Date names or display text with showLogsAsText.

docs.title: Debug Log
docs.description: Append previous native output without coercion. Optional withDates captures original Creation Date at source; showLogs previews native objects (with Set Name by Creation Date when enabled); showLogsAsText opts into Combine Text or dated text rows.

docs.title: Log Previous Result
docs.description: Alias for debugLog with optional withDates/showLogs/showLogsAsText.

docs.title: Show Debug Logs
docs.description: Preview native objects, naming items by Creation Date when enabled; use showLogsAsText for text formatting.

docs.title: Start Debug Timer
docs.description: Remember the current time under a compile-time label.

docs.title: Stop Debug Timer
docs.description: Measure elapsed seconds and append the result to the execution-local log.

docs.title: Trace Value and Time
docs.description: Append current time followed by a value to the execution-local debug log.

docs.title: Record QA Structured Trace Event
docs.description: Append a structured JSONL trace record (stage, label, step sequence, and CurrentDate timestamp) to the execution-local QA trace buffer without mutating __cherri_debug_log.

docs.title: Measure Block
docs.description: V2 scoped value block. Evaluate once, log elapsed seconds through existing native timers, and return the original typed value. Runtime timing accuracy remains platform-dependent.

parameters.label: nextKey
parameters.displayName: Next URL or sibling filename key

docs.title: Paginate Bounded Dictionary Pages
docs.description: Traverse native Dictionary page bodies with ordered Dictionary items and a body next marker. Next accepts same-origin absolute URLs or simple sibling filenames. Exact resolved-URL hash cycles, absent/empty next and literal caps stop traversal; either zero cap emits no GET. No headers, Link parsing, HTTP status verification, retry, transport timeout or trailing block contract. Native runtime acceptance remains required.

docs.title: Require Typed Value
docs.description: Validate text, number or dictionary native content and optional nonempty character/key/item count, then return the original value. Type and nonEmpty are compile-time literals.

requirements.name: Typed require
requirements.acceptanceRequirement: Return the original typed object after semantic validation; failure stops with the supplied message.
limitations: Full false/zero/null/empty/native-object matrix and native failure/cancel proof are not established by this ledger.

requirements.name: debugLog labels
requirements.acceptanceRequirement: Stable per-entry labels without replacing the original raw object or its downstream UUID.
externalPrerequisites: Native file/object identity and six-mode label acceptance
limitations: Per-entry metadata and bounded source contracts are implemented; signed File-carrier byte identity still requires repair and acceptance.

requirements.name: Local debugExport
requirements.acceptanceRequirement: Local returned file; typed JSON/text or explicit opaque placeholders; safe escaping and default redaction.
limitations: Local File export source supports default full redaction and explicit Text-only base64 payloads; structured types, dates/labels, selective redaction and native acceptance remain open. QA debugExportTrace is separate.

requirements.name: Shared typed block facility
requirements.acceptanceRequirement: Scoped typed block/IR, one evaluation, shadowing, value/void, nesting and explicit unavailable-dialect diagnostics.
limitations: The implemented V2 measure value block is a bounded subset; general void/early-error blocks and a safe Legacy route remain open.

requirements.name: Measure typed value
requirements.acceptanceRequirement: Evaluate the body once, preserve its native result and remove only timing instrumentation in Release.
externalPrerequisites: Apple timing accuracy and error/cancel observation
limitations: Legacy block syntax is deliberately rejected; structural UUID/timer checks are not native elapsed-time proof.

requirements.name: Typed collection
requirements.acceptanceRequirement: Use existing native Repeat Results without a second accumulator or standalone alias; account separately for typed input construction.
externalPrerequisites: Native empty/mixed/nested collection shape and performance observation
limitations: No standalone collect alias is introduced. Compiled Repeat Results does not prove runtime flattening behavior.

requirements.name: Persistent TTL cache
requirements.acceptanceRequirement: Explicit namespace/scope/TTL and honest serialization, invalidation, clock and permission behavior.
limitations: Existing storage definitions are prerequisites, not a cache implementation; current storeValue exposes text.

requirements.name: Bounded retry
requirements.acceptanceRequirement: Bounded attempts/backoff with actual transport/status/permission/cancel classification and idempotence safeguards.
externalPrerequisites: Recoverable native error/status contract and signed synthetic endpoint probes
limitations: No evidence establishes catchable transport failures; Alert plus Stop Shortcut is not exception handling.

requirements.name: Bounded pagination
requirements.acceptanceRequirement: Explicit limits/cursor termination, typed aggregation and malformed/error/rate-limit/credential safeguards.
limitations: The shared bounded GET/body-cursor implementation has page/item limits and cycle guards. Response headers/status, transport recovery, redirect limits and generic retry remain outside its proven contract.

requirements.name: Debug and Release
requirements.acceptanceRequirement: Compile-time diagnostic removal while retaining semantic require checks and original native producers.
externalPrerequisites: Native result equivalence and debug-mode acceptance
limitations: The controlled compiler comparisons cover declared fixtures; they do not establish every diagnostic or runtime path.

requirements.name: Macro QA and consumers
requirements.acceptanceRequirement: Generated evidence, canonical metadata/docs and coherent Skill/iOS/remote consumer acceptance.
externalPrerequisites: Final pinned consumer tuple and signed/physical acceptance evidence
limitations: This ledger builds and tests a compiler; it does not install a Skill, update a provider or execute on Apple.
